company.name: Creditas
company.shortDescription: Creditas is a consumer loaning startup that operates a digital platform providing secured loans and low interest rates.
company.description:
Creditas is a financial technology company that operates a digital platform that offers secured consumer loans. It uses credit scoring systems and borrowers’ assets, such as homes and automobiles as collateral to offer loans. 

Sergio Furio founded BankFacil in 2012 that later became Creditas. It has its headquarters in São Paulo in Brazil.

productsAndServices.description: A secured loan using a vehicle as collateral, offering credit from R$5,000 to R$150,000 with interest rates starting at 1.49% per month and repayment terms up to 60 months.
productsAndServices.name: Empréstimo com garantia de veículo (Vehicle-Backed Loan)

productsAndServices.description: A secured loan using real estate property as collateral, offering credit up to R$3 million with interest rates starting at 1.09% per month plus IPCA and repayment terms up to 240 months.
productsAndServices.name: Empréstimo com garantia de imóvel (Real Estate-Backed Loan)

productsAndServices.description: A loan secured by the borrower's salary with fixed installments up to 35% of salary, offering credit from R$300 to R$70,000 and repayment terms up to 60 months.
productsAndServices.name: Empréstimo consignado privado (Private Payroll-Deductible Loan)

productsAndServices.description: An online auto insurance service offering coverage options from up to 16 insurers, with digital contracting and payment in up to 10 installments without interest.
productsAndServices.name: Seguro Auto (Auto Insurance)

productsAndServices.description: A real estate financing service that allows customers to simulate and compare offers from up to 8 banks, financing up to 90% of the property value with repayment terms up to 35 years.

productsAndServices.description: A vehicle financing service that compares offers from up to 6 institutions, providing assistance with documentation and approval for private vehicle purchases.
productsAndServices.name: Financiamento de veículo particular (Private Vehicle Financing)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $27,500,000, or 2.2% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 15 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $287,567,402 to $3,300,000,000, a 11.48x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (-19 over 90 days) and market heat at 42 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Strategic repositioning and listing coverage shape the current narrative
insights.statement: Creditas has a recent strategic-positioning change; 1 recent unique news titles explicitly contain the English terms IPO or listing.
insights.implication: Their timing coincides with increased visibility in the loaded news and Crunchbase momentum signals, but the data does not establish causation.
caveats: The causal link to Crunchbase momentum is an inference from timing, not a disclosed company metric.

insights.title: IPO intent and modeled likelihood conflict
insights.statement: Recent headline metadata discusses an IPO or listing, while Crunchbase’s model assigns a 84.64% IPO probability.
insights.implication: Publicly discussed intent should not be treated as proof of execution; the conflict is a useful diligence flag for verifying filing status, timing, and exchange readiness.
caveats: The prediction is an opaque model output and may lag current company plans.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Ecx Card, Trio Card, Up Brasil.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
